Planet Zybex: level background preview

Browser checks and captured frames

First milestone toward a playable Planet Zybex showcase. The seven original packed level banks decode through the original Load/Unpack statements; 35 scrolled windows match independent pixels and actual WebGL output. The full game still needs AMAL, computed/wide sprites and update control. This is a background preview, not gameplay.
